blinded_inputs.commitment_key: operator-held HMAC key; never in published evidence
blinded_inputs.evaluator_seed: per-world independent evaluation seeds derived from operator-held material; raw seeds held by the evaluator until outcome lock; never in the manifest or evidence. Only the DERIVED rule tables are sealed at genesis - the raw seed is not
blinded_inputs.hidden_tables: sealed ledger only, keyed commitments in public events

call_budget.note: decision slots are computational; a model send happens only for model-backed arms at exactly one send per slot

holds: historical W/H/D results are not rewritten
no outcome-based retuning after results are seen
negative results are preserved as first-class records

operational_contract.physical_send_meter: call_contract.py is accounting and policy, not a runtime meter; an enforcing send meter is implemented before any authorized execution

statistical_plan.analysis_method: mean of the per-world paired differences with a two-sided 95% confidence interval over worlds; preregistered paired test; the independent world is the unit of analysis
statistical_plan.confidence_interval: 95% t-based confidence interval on the per-world paired differences
statistical_plan.decision_correlation: planning power/MDE is reported over an intra-world decision-correlation (rho) sensitivity grid via power.intra_world_correlation_table; MDE values are scenario-specific under declared rho assumptions, not guarantees
statistical_plan.hypothesis: Across independent worlds, a model-mediated agent whose per-context experience memory persists across a counterbalanced hidden-rule switch achieves higher post-switch accuracy than the paired agent whose memory is ablated at the switch, under identical shared acquisition history, sealed evaluator rules, and equal information.
statistical_plan.incomplete_worlds: worlds with failed/expired sends are apparatus failures; not replaced; analysis runs on analyzable worlds with a minimum analyzable worlds floor of 18 (proposed-pending-freeze); apparatus failures recorded separately
statistical_plan.practical_success: lower bound of the 95% CI > 0.20 (independent criterion; both claims reported separately)
statistical_plan.primary_estimand: paired post-switch accuracy difference post_accuracy(arm A) - post_accuracy(arm B), one difference per independent world
statistical_plan.statistical_test: two-sided paired t-test over the per-world post-switch accuracy differences
